author: GitHub
description:
Your team might agree on what to build, but how to build it is another conversation. In this GitHub Universe 2026 session, join Pierce Boggan, Burke Holland, James Montemagno, Julia Kasper, and Katie Savage as they tackle a shared project with GitHub Copilot, bringing their favorite tools, models, and personal workflows. Working across the Copilot app, CLI, VS Code, and JetBrains, the team puts AI agents to work, carries context between tasks, and takes development beyond the editor while balancing speed, cost, and control. Follow the project from concept to working software to see how Copilot helps teams build together without forcing everyone into the same setup. 

Speakers: 

Burke Holland, Principal Cloud Advocate, Microsoft 
James Montemagno, Principal Technical PM Lead, Microsoft 
Julia Kasper, Product Manager, Microsoft 
Katie Savage, Technical Program Manager, Microsoft 
Pierce Boggan, Product - GitHub Copilot, GitHub 

Watch more videos from GitHub Universe 2026: https://www.
title: Work together, your way, with GitHub Copilot

author: GitHub
description:
A scanner can tell you a package has a known CVE, but with hundreds of alerts, severity alone doesn't always tell you what matters. In this Security in 60 Seconds short, Carlin Cherry walks through three more questions to ask: Is the dependency actually used? Can your application reach the vulnerable code? Is it exposed in a production path? Reachability analysis and production context in Dependabot help answer them. Treat them as starting points alongside severity and EPSS, and choose the signals that fit your team.

Learn more about reachability analysis: https://gh.io/reachability
Learn more about production context: https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/tutorials/secure-your-organization/prioritize-alerts-in-production-code
